mods.name: architecture-guard
mods.description: Checks imports in edited TypeScript, JavaScript and Java files against the layer rules in configuration. Existing violations in the baseline are grandfathered; only new ones are warned about or refused.

mods.name: behavior-lock
mods.description: Captures the exported surface of TypeScript or JavaScript files before a refactoring, then compares it afterwards. Removed or changed exports fail the gate; added exports are reported as additive. The surface is read as text, not type-checked.

mods.name: boss-fight
mods.description: Shows the test check as a boss battle above the prompt: the boss stands while the test check fails and falls when it passes. It reads evidence-gate's published state and changes nothing.

mods.name: cache-clock
mods.description: Shows how long the prompt cache from the last turn is expected to stay warm. It only displays the estimate and never sends requests to keep it warm.

mods.name: change-contract
mods.description: Holds the task's objective, allowed and forbidden paths. Writes outside the contract are warned about or refused, according to its mode.

mods.name: change-planner
mods.description: Records the change plan (objective, files, tests, risks) and turns it into a change contract. Publishes the plan gate for the delivery workflows.

mods.name: ci-triage
mods.description: Classifies a CI failure log (compilation, unit, integration, flaky, infrastructure, credentials, lint, security, performance) and recommends the next action. It stops the loop when the cause is infrastructure or credentials, because more code edits cannot fix those.

mods.name: code-pet
mods.description: A small status creature above the prompt whose mood follows the evidence state and how much tool activity the turn has had. It reads evidence-gate's published state and changes nothing.

mods.name: command-guard
mods.description: Holds destructive shell commands for a decision, refuses the unsafe ones outright, and keeps secret files out of edits and reads.

mods.name: commentary
mods.description: A one-line commentary above the prompt about the latest tool activity, in a sportscaster or monologue voice, chosen with /commentary. Templated: it makes no model calls.

mods.name: contract-compatibility-guard
mods.description: Runs the compatibility tools configured for this repository (OpenAPI diff, buf breaking, GraphQL inspector, Pact and similar) and records their results. It does not analyse schemas itself. Publishes the compatibility gate.

mods.name: debug-timeline
mods.description: Records the commands run during debugging, the hypotheses proposed and their outcomes, and flags repeated commands so circular investigation is visible.

mods.name: defect-protocol
mods.description: Tracks a defect from symptom to root cause to fix and regression test. A defect counts as reproduced only with a reproduction or a documented reason it cannot be reproduced. Publishes the defect gate.

mods.name: dependency-radar
mods.description: Diffs direct dependencies when a manifest or lockfile is edited (added, removed, major-version changes), and reads scanner results saved under .agentic-mods/scans. It never contacts the network.

mods.name: design-patterns
mods.description: Design-pattern lookup mod: indexes all 22 GoF patterns with use-when and idiom-first lines, and adds a /patterns command to look one up, list a category, or suggest candidates for a described problem

mods.name: engineering-cockpit
mods.description: One pane with the verification state of the change: contract, impact, evidence, review, architecture, migration, dependencies, performance and release readiness. It reads what the other mods publish and changes nothing.

mods.name: evidence-gate
mods.description: Runs the configured build, test, lint, type-check and security commands, records their exit codes against a fingerprint of the repository, and holds git commit, push and PR creation until the required checks are current.

mods.name: guardian
mods.description: Tool governance mod: redacts secrets from Bash/Write/Edit tool calls, and blocks destructive shell commands (rm -rf, force pushes, prod migrations) with an explanation, so nothing sensitive or irreversible runs silently

mods.name: incident-timeline
mods.description: Records an incident as an append-only timeline, switches command-guard to its strict profile while it is open, and writes the postmortem.

mods.name: learning-ledger
mods.description: Keeps repository lessons as reviewable records. A lesson is proposed, then approved by the person, and goes stale when a file it cites changes.

mods.name: markdown-preview
mods.description: Renders a Markdown file from the repository in a pane, so READMEs, ADRs and reports can be read without leaving the session.

mods.name: migration-sentinel
mods.description: Reviews SQL migration edits for destructive and table-locking changes, records the verdict for release readiness, and never executes SQL.

mods.name: mission-control
mods.description: Shows subagents as a tree: what each is doing, which files it touched, its tool calls, and a plain-language line per agent. Review agents are flagged. Templated from events, with no model calls.

mods.name: mod-firewall
mods.description: Watches network requests and process launches made by other mods, enforces an allowlist, and keeps an audit trail.

mods.name: mod-template
mods.description: Starter mod for the agentic-mods library: counts tool-call attempts, shows the count beside the spinner, adds /mod-template-tally and /mod-template-usage

mods.name: next-steps
mods.description: After a turn that changed files, offers up to three suggested next prompts in a row above the prompt. Taking one puts it in the prompt box for editing.

mods.name: observability-verifier
mods.description: Checks the health endpoints configured in .agentic-mods/observability.json after a change, and publishes the observability gate. It makes GET requests only, through the host's network policy.

mods.name: performance-budget
mods.description: Compares measurements from benchmark and bundle-size reports against the budgets in .agentic-mods/budgets.json. A missing measurement is UNKNOWN, never a pass.

mods.name: pr-readiness
mods.description: Combines scope, evidence, review and architecture into one readiness verdict, and drafts a pull-request verification section from recorded results only.

mods.name: pulse
mods.description: Session observability mod: tracks tool-call attempts per tool, estimates context-window pressure, and shows a compact live readout beside the spinner plus /pulse-report and /pulse-usage commands

mods.name: regression-orchestrator
mods.description: Scores the regression risk of the working tree, explains the score, and runs the configured scope for its level. Publishes the regression gate. Commands are configured per repository in .agentic-mods/regression.json.

mods.name: release-conductor
mods.description: Assembles release readiness from the evidence, review, architecture, migration, dependency and performance states, plus a changelog, a rollback note and the deployment assets the repository lists. Checks only: it never deploys, and writes the checklist to .agentic-mods/release/checklist.md. The changelog counts when CHANGELOG.md changed in the working tree or since the last tag.

mods.name: response-modes
mods.description: Adds a concise or plain-language response style to the system prompt, switched with /tldr, /mode-simple and /mode-off.

mods.name: review-tracker
mods.description: Turns review findings into tracked records with a lifecycle and a required reason or evidence at each resolution. Unresolved high-severity findings fail the review gate.

mods.name: sdlc
mods.description: Complete SDLC kit: an 8-stage feature lifecycle (clarify > PRD > spec > plan > TDD build > review > debug > release) with slash commands, sub-agent roles, templates and checklists

mods.name: session-meter
mods.description: Shows context fill, session cost and rate-limit windows above the prompt, and warns when a threshold is crossed.

mods.name: session-wrapped
mods.description: Counts the session's turns, tool calls and file edits, and shows a text summary with /wrapped. It does not create images and writes nothing to disk.

mods.name: specification-guard
mods.description: Checks acceptance criteria are written as Given/When/Then scenarios with the non-functional sections. Publishes the specification gate for the delivery workflows.

mods.name: switchboard
mods.description: Warns when two sessions edit the same file at once, lists current file claims, and sends a message to another session only when the person asks.

mods.name: task-orientation
mods.description: Keeps the goal, current task, blocker and next step visible in a pane, captured from the first prompt and set with commands.

mods.name: tdd-conductor
mods.description: Runs the RED, GREEN and REFACTOR cycle. RED counts only when the test fails for a behavioral reason. Production edits are refused outside the implementation and refactor phases, unless an exception is recorded. Publishes the TDD gate.

mods.name: test-impact
mods.description: Maps changed JavaScript and TypeScript files to the tests that import them, flags changed code that no test reaches, and recommends the full suite for shared configuration. It selects tests and never runs them.

mods.name: trace
mods.description: Execution observability mod: builds a bounded hierarchical runtime tree (main agent -> subagents -> tool calls) from session/turn/agent.spawn/tool events, and exposes /trace-tree and /trace-summary commands

mods.name: turn-replay
mods.description: Records every Edit and Write as a diff, grouped by turn, and shows them one at a time in a pane so a large change can be reviewed in steps.

mods.name: verify
mods.description: Runs the verification checks a repository declares under evidence.commands and passes only when every command exits 0. Only declared commands run, each once, under the process policy. The adapter lives in mods/verify; the check logic lives in packages/core.

mods.name: workflow-conductor
mods.description: Runs delivery workflows. Feature development and bug fixes are run by the Agentic SDLC Kit, which owns their state and evidence; this mod asks the kit what is next and runs the phase it names. Regression, refactoring, pull request, release, hotfix, incident and TDD workflows run on this mod's stage engine, where a stage advances only when its gate's evidence is current or an approved deferral is recorded.

mods.name: worktree-orchestrator
mods.description: Lists git worktrees with their branches and uncommitted changes, and reports files that are changed in more than one worktree. Read-only: it never creates, removes or merges worktrees.

mods.name: sdlc-guard
mods.description: Runtime governance Mod: destructive-operation protection, approval gates, migration and deployment controls. Uses the M10 policy evaluator and action classification.

mods.name: secret-guard
mods.description: Secret protection Mod: detect and redact secrets in tool output, file writes, and git operations. Uses the M11 detector and redactor.

mods.name: model-router
mods.description: Model + effort routing Mod: classify task complexity and risk, select model and effort, preserve explicit user choices, escalate on verification failure.

mods.name: run-observer
mods.description: Execution observability Mod: collect session/turn/tool events, persist run reports, redact sensitive output, CLI-first observability via kit runs.
